name: Taki Ibuki
source:
Born in Okinawa and raised in America, Ibuki goes around without a care in the world but can also be quick to start a fight. He's an eloquent speaker and a logical thinker despite his age. He was invited by Nice to the reality competition show "4piece" and is participating because it piqued his interest.

[Translated from [url=https://ensemble-stars.jp/characters/taki_ibuki/]official website[/url]]
